## Publication Information

**Date:** 1848

**Genre:** Fiction (modern)

**Publisher:** John and Charles Mozley, 6, Paternoster Row, London, and Joseph Masters, 78, New Bond Street, London

**Notes:** Copies in Lambeth Palace Library,  University of Sheffield Library and the University of Delaware Library. It was reprinted in <i>The Christmas Mummers and Other Stories</i> (1876).
